prompt:
Paint ONE original ground-material swatch for the isometric railway game, requested canvas 1024x1024 pixels, real PNG fully opaque. References in order: theme-town-growth is STYLE and palette only; rock-surface is approved SCALE, finish and cluster-size reference, not material; ref-water and ref-sand are HUE ONLY crops of blocky tiles: do not copy their diamond silhouette, blocky pixels or streaks. Match smooth painted contours and broad colour clusters, three or four shades, no per-pixel noise or stair-stepped edges. Flat square sample of ground as seen by a 2:1 orthographic isometric game camera 30 degrees down, screen-aligned. No object or tile shape: fill every pixel evenly through all four edges. One upper-left light. Square spans about three tiles: one tile ~330x165 source pixels; tenth-tile pebble ~33 px, twentieth ~17 px. The location at tile offset (x,y) is (512+165*(x-y),512+82.5*(x+y)). Paint material only, no scene, diamond, tile edge, border, horizon, perspective convergence, cast shadow, central motif, identical repeating shapes, long parallel lines, standing plants or rocks, boats, people, lettering or glow. Desired soft edge seamlessness. Quiet painted game illustration, not photorealistic grain. General palette forest #294638, moss #78804C, oat #E4D5B5, limestone #BCA98B, slate #626B6C, water #477B82, copper #A36B42.
MATERIAL: Still lake water, darker and calmer than sea: dominant #3E6E78, with #487C84 base and restrained #548A92 lit shades; #649EA2 is maximum brightness. Broad soft tone changes, almost no glints, faint smooth sheen. Low detail, quiet and even across entire surface. Game adds its own faint ripple strokes; keep glints few and contrast low.
